read_wav — ONED io op

• Data kinds: file → signal

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.read_wav(path) (to call the implementation directly, import dsp; dsp.read_wav(path); from the registry, ops1d.get("read_wav"))

Usage

Read a WAV file (stdlib) -> `(x float64 [-1,1], rate)`. Multi-channel is averaged to mono. Handles 8/16/32-bit PCM.
